name: Overdue invoices
expect: A table with the client as row header, amounts aligned to the end, status as a Status in its own column, and one primary action such as sending reminders

name: Notification settings
expect: Switches that take effect at once with no Save button, grouped by channel, in a narrow column

name: Shop dashboard
ask: How did the shop do this week?
expect: Stat cards in a Grid with the figure as a title, a short answer in words, and a table or list of what sold, not a wall of cards

name: Sign-up form
ask: A sign-up form for a design newsletter
expect: Few fields, labels not placeholders, a narrow column, one primary button that says what happens, no disabled button

name: Booking from the date picker page
ask: Use this for a holiday cottage booking form
expect: A DateRangePicker for the stay, not two DatePickers, a minimum date of today, guests as a NumberField, and one primary button

name: Team members
ask: A page to manage my team’s members and invite someone new
expect: Members in a table or list with their role and status, an invite action, per-row actions in a Menu, and a dialog or form for the invite

name: Orders with filters
ask: A list of orders I can search and filter by status, with pages
expect: A SearchField over the table, filters as a TagGroup or segmented control, a table, and Pagination under it

name: No projects yet
ask: What should my projects page show before anyone has made a project?
expect: An EmptyState that says what will be here and how to start, with one action; short words alongside

name: Delete a workspace
ask: A danger zone for deleting a workspace, with a confirmation
expect: A danger Button opening a Dialog that names what will be lost, with a danger confirm that says what happens and a Cancel

name: Checkout summary
ask: A checkout page with the order summary beside the delivery details
expect: A Split with the summary in the narrow end column, amounts with tabular figures, a narrow form, and one primary button to pay

name: Help page
ask: A help page with common questions about billing
expect: Disclosures for the questions, a search over them perhaps, and a way to contact support

name: A question about a component
ask: When should I use this rather than a radio group?
expect: Looks Select up rather than answering from memory, answers in words, and draws nothing or a small comparison

name: Something it can’t draw
ask: Draw me a line chart of sign-ups over the last year
expect: Says plainly that charts can’t be drawn here, offers the nearest it can, such as stats or a table by month, and doesn’t fake a chart

name: A view with controls
ask: A pricing card I can tweak, with three plans
expect: Values and controls for what’s worth adjusting, such as spacing and which plan is picked out, rather than buttons asking to redraw

name: Changing a view
then: Make the table denser and add a column for how many days overdue
expect: The second view keeps the first one’s data and layout, with a compact table and the new column, rather than a new design
